name: Richard Heiden
source:
Client of Kia's secret mission.

He wants Kia to separate his stepmother from his father, Gardes Heiden. [spoiler]However, it turns out this was a trick. He had fallen in love with his stepmother first and thought his dad "stole" her from him.
